label: Linear
title: Linear switches
about: Smooth switches with no bump. Listen for a steady, even sound.

label: Clicky
title: Clicky (Cherry MX Blue)
about: These switches click on purpose. Watch the CLACK zone light up.

label: Tactile
title: Tactile (Hako Violet, WhiteFox board)
about: A small bump you can feel, but no click.

label: Vintage Alps
title: Vintage board (lubed Alps switches, PBT caps)
about: An old-school keyboard with modded switches and thick PBT keycaps.

label: Mic spot A
title: Same keyboard, mic spot A (above the left side)
about: Leopold FC660M with MX Brown switches. Compare with mic spot B: same keyboard, different mic spot!

label: Mic spot B
title: Same keyboard, mic spot B (in front of the spacebar)
about: The very same keyboard as mic spot A. Any difference you see comes from where the mic was. That's why fair tests matter!
